# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Register exact per-language consumer packages, tests, APIs, and stable-error adapters in a closed schema.

## 1.0.0 - 2026-09-27

- Define closed, bounded contracts for ITF, Code 39, Codabar, Code 128-B,
  UPC-A, and EAN-13.
- Pin ASCII-only normalization, exact module and run outputs, checksum and
  parity behavior, empty-input policies, stable errors, and atomic failures.
- Add deterministic boundary digests for the 4,096-scalar resource ceiling.
